verdicts.reason: A: the product circle is jammed against the top-left canvas edges, 'Out now.' sits below and to the left of the CTA pill so the pair reads as jumbled, and the bottom ~40% of the canvas is dead orange space. B has a clean, centered, story-style structure, but the hierarchy is inverted: the huge product circle dominates while the headline is tiny at the top, the 'Try It' pill is small, and 'Out now.' is near-illegible and floats alone at bottom right. B still looks more deliberately arranged.
